approved_shape_progression.body_growth: Exactly one upright square sticky-note sheet is the whole creature. Its top edge bends backward to expose a broad adhesive strip. One lower corner peels forward and the opposite lower corner curls into a tiny balancing toe. The face consists of two separate eyes on the broad flat page, not on a projecting triangular animal muzzle.
approved_shape_progression.silhouette: One nearly square page, one peeled upper corner and two small curled lower corners; no separate animal head, tail, torso or added arms.
approved_shape_progression.back: Close independent rear of the same single note, showing its rolled sticky top edge and blank square reverse. No face on the back.

approved_shape_progression.body_growth: Exactly three square notes overlap at their sticky top edges. The original central upright face note is larger, with one side note peeling forward on each side as a broad reaching sheet. The two side notes hang slightly below the face and curl at their lower corners. There is no accordion animal spine or separate hood.
approved_shape_progression.silhouette: Three visibly square sheets in a short offset fan: one central face and two broad side sheets. Their overlap seams form the body; no hidden flesh, paper dinosaur, legs or long neck.
approved_shape_progression.back: Close rear of the central page and two upper overlapping side-note roots; large sticky-edge fold seams, blank reverse sides.

approved_shape_progression.body_growth: Exactly seven broad sticky-note sheets form a self-sorting keeper. The original large face note remains central. A staggered stack of two notes sits to each side of it, with the near left and near right sheets peeling forward as exactly two square note hands. Two lower sheets form a low overlapping base, their outer lower corners curling forward. Total: one face, four side-stack sheets, two base sheets. The upper sticky-edge overlaps connect every part.
approved_shape_progression.silhouette: Broad stepped square-page keeper with a large central square face, two peel-forward square note hands and a short curled-page base. Wider than tall; no animal head, neck, horns, spines, quadruped body, tail or wings.
approved_shape_progression.back: Independent close upper-rear portrait: blank reverse of central face note, tops of the two stepped side stacks and the near folded note-hand roots. Crop the lower base; do not fit all seven whole sheets into the rear box.

battle_role: Slow tactical Psychic reminder/control keeper: adhesive StringShot slows; Encore/Disable exploit a predicted repeated action; Mimic/PsychUp recall observed patterns; screens protect its paper structure. Native Psychic/Psybeam supply ordinary damage, FutureSight is a delayed reminder. No new ability, trapping rule, new move or special signature mechanic.

balance.physical_counterplay: FinalDefense80 andSpeed45 leave clear physical Bug/Dark/Ghost pressure. HighSpecialDefense125 supports its deliberate wall/control role without giving an ability or new resistance.
removed_nonfunctional_or_overloaded_tool: DREAM_EATER removed because the line has no dedicated sleep setup.
BATON_PASS andAMNESIA removed to avoid combining broad boost passing withhighspecialbulk, screens andRecover.
DOUBLE_TEAM omitted from the new narrow control proposal.
balance.no_direct_boost_move: PsychUp only copies existing stage changes; no standalone CalmMind/new boost mechanic.
balance.limits: Encore/Disable/Mimic require the actual native engine state and can fail. MindReader maps to existing LOCK_ON effect and only affects accuracy; it is not telepathy or an invented instant-hit damage mechanic. FutureSight retains native quirks. SlowSpeed means the line must take a hit or predict correctly.
